info.title: ExpenseWise API
info.description: The API behind the ExpenseWise web and iOS apps. Money is always integer minor units plus an ISO 4217 code. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents.

bearerAuth.description: A Supabase Auth access token for a signed-in user.

assuranceLevel.description: aal2 means this session passed multi-factor authentication.

keyHint.description: The last four characters of the stored key.

authScheme.description: How the provider accepted the key: as an API key header or a bearer token.

apiKey.description: The key from the provider. It is checked with the provider, then stored encrypted and never returned.

reason.description: Why the key could not be used, when valid is false.

detail.description: What the provider answered, when it answered. Never the key.

current.description: Whether this is the sign-in making the request.

accessToken.description: An access token for the other sign-in, from signing in with it moments ago. With the request's own token it proves the caller controls both. Used once, never stored.

token.description: Uploads one file to this path, once.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lowercase hex.

status.description: processing while it is read; extracted (shown as Ready) when both compared models read it with confidence and agree, or when a member confirmed or corrected a reading (ADR-0021); needs_review otherwise, including when only the fallback model read it; failed when no model could read it.

assumed.description: True for a tax or tip the receipt does not print, taken as zero rather than read. Never set when the line is printed but unreadable, or when the printed figures leave an amount unaccounted for.

code.description: failed: no model could read it. fallback: only the fallback model read it. differ: the compared models read the filing fields differently. checks: its sums or date fail a check, or it is a purchase summary (FR-INT-04). unsure: a model was not confident, or one could not read it.

error.description: failed: why the first compared model could not read it, such as no_key.

values.description: What the receipt is filed with.

read.description: What the model read; null when it read nothing.

ReceiptConfirmation.description: Set when a member confirmed this reading; the merchant, date and total above are then the confirmed values.

model.description: The reading to confirm, by model, from the receipt’s latest readings.

merchant.description: The merchant, as it should be filed.

currency.description: An ISO 4217 code. Amounts keep their printed value.

total.description: A plain decimal in the receipt’s currency.

taxTotal.description: A plain decimal in the receipt’s currency.

tip.description: A plain decimal in the receipt’s currency.

corrections.description: Only the fields the person changed. Omit to confirm as read.

status.description: processing while its receipt is read; ready when its receipt is Ready and merchant, date, currency and amount are filled in; needs_review otherwise. Submitted, approved and settled follow its report; approved is locked (FR-EXP-03).

owner.description: The member whose expense it is.

trip.description: The trip it is filed to (FR-EXP-04), or null for none.

tripFiledBy.description: date: it files to the trip its date falls in, and moves when the dates do. person: a person chose its trip, or chose none, and filing by date leaves it there (ADR-0023).

matchesReceipt.description: Whether merchant, date, currency and amount match what its receipt shows. Null without a receipt.

editable.description: Whether it can be edited now: while it needs review or is Ready.

editedAt.description: When a person last edited it. A reading never overwrites an edit.

confirmedBy.description: Who confirmed the receipt’s reading, if anyone.

differences.description: Where the expense differs from its receipt.

currency.description: An ISO 4217 code. The amount keeps its written value.

amount.description: A plain decimal in the expense’s currency.

tripId.description: The trip to put it on, or null for no trip.

byDate.description: File it to the trip its date falls in again.

days.description: Days it covers, both ends included.

owner.description: The member whose trip it is.

readyCount.description: Expenses that are Ready, or further along: submitted or later.

totals.description: What its expenses add up to, one total per currency, never converted. Expenses with no amount yet count in none.

expenses.description: In date order; those with no date yet last.

purpose.description: Why you went. Up to 500 characters.

endDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the last day, included. A trip is at most 366 days.

day.description: now: which day of the trip it is.

from.description: The first day of the month the day is in.

ready.description: Of those, how many are Ready or further along.

spent.description: One total per currency, never converted.

recentTrips.description: The last trips to end before the day, latest first.

get.description: Returns 200 while the API can serve requests. Does not touch the database.

Connects to the database the way tenant requests do and checks what tenant isolation depends on: the runtime role, verified TLS and enforced row-level security. Results are cached for a few seconds. Details are fixed messages, never raw errors.

post.summary: Add another sign-in for the same person
post.description: Links a second sign-in, such as a work email, to the caller. The body carries an access token for that sign-in, so the caller proves control of both. If the other sign-in had created its own organization and left it empty, it moves; otherwise nothing changes.

post.summary: Bird calls this when an email arrives at the receipts address
post.description: Signed by Bird with the Standard Webhooks scheme; the signature, not a sign-in, is what lets it in, and a delivery more than 5 minutes off is refused. An arriving email is handed to a background workflow, which fetches it, checks its sender and files its attachments as receipts (FR-CAP-02, ADR-0026). Other events are acknowledged and ignored.

200.description: An event email-in does not use; nothing was done.

202.description: The email will be read in the background.

400.description: The event is not one Bird would send.

401.description: The signature is missing, wrong or too old.

503.description: Email-in is not configured here, or the hand-off failed; Bird tries again.
